recommendation: Keep the audit commit for the current core branch. If Citation is reintroduced into core or maintained in another specification, carry forward the FHIR-48333 pattern: code type, required all-languages binding, and starter languages additional binding.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive CDS issue requesting Citation language elements use type code with a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/all-languages and an additional starter binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages instead of a preferred languages binding.
initial_application: The Jira comment linked HL7/fhir#3239. Merge commit 40bf7639b6dc787c9c190fe6cad592e961ffdf84, with branch commits 9070fa27695da6cf193340d55ddbc0a7c4d85522 and 9adfac2acb5dfcf563c7993efffd167026b32c46, updated source/citation/structuredefinition-Citation.xml so Citation language elements used code plus required all-languages with languages as a starter additional binding.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread identified Citation as the only core exception to the normal all-languages pattern, and CDS minutes recorded a 21-0-1 vote to accept the suggested resolution. Later commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/citation and the active Citation build entry from core. The current fhir.ini resource list has no Citation entry, the current tree has no source/citation directory, and an Extension Pack check found Citation-related extensions but no base Citation resource definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No source change is appropriate because the issue was applied while Citation was in core and the current core build has no Citation source artifact to fix.
